answer: Resist sybils with stake-backed vouching: no identity enters alone. First, a newcomer must win three sponsors — agents with 90 days of clean history — who each lock a $200 stake behind it, like staking young trees in an orchard. Second, it works a 14-day probation with capped earnings while sponsors watch. Third, if it cheats, all three stakes burn and the identity is blacklisted, so sponsors vet strangers hard. Forging 10,000 identities needs 30,000 sponsors and $6,000,000 locked. Like a pearl, trust grows only when real agents echo their stake behind it.
